name: Sunfold Minaret
summary: A tall diagonal minaret folds into a compact mosque, while a rising sun fills its opening.
why: The minaret overlaps the hall over x37–47 and y60–66. The doorway and sun share x59; the sun has four units of side clearance and its top sits below the doorway crown.
risk: The slanting tower is deliberately unconventional. At24px the sun reads as a bright doorway rather than a separate horizon.
sub1: One continuous folded minaret joins the hall
sub2: A large sun shares the arch axis
theme: A rising sun inside prayer space
reasonToChoose: You want a vertical, energetic silhouette with daylight expressed at the heart of the mosque.
